$description: Motion tokens. Minor and subtle only. Every animation has a purpose and a static fallback under prefers-reduced-motion.

allowed.element: fern icon accent (leaf highlight on hover)
allowed.note: Optional quirk. Opacity only, no transform.
Optional. Content must be visible without JS and without motion.

forbidden: Animation of layout properties (width, height, top, left)
Any motion that is required to read or use content

reduced_motion.rule: Disable all transitions and animations. Color and opacity changes become instant. Content is fully visible and usable without any motion.
reduced_motion.css: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
